intro: Set your display name, avatar, and background. The avatar is used in direct-mode captions and similar UI.
avatarHelp: Click the circle to upload; used in subtitles and assistant UI.
displayNameHelp: Leave blank to use the default name.
backgroundHelp: Describe your role or preferences. The assistant uses this as context.
backgroundPlaceholder: e.g. On-call monitoring, focus on SE Asia routes…
avatarTooLarge: Image is still too large after compression. Try a smaller file.

password.title: Admin password
password.help: Change the admin password. Other signed-in devices keep working until they refresh or you revoke them.

devices.title: Devices
devices.intro: UI device sessions for browsers and desktop clients signed in with the admin password. Revoke a device to sign it out remotely. Webhooks should use API keys, not device sessions.
devices.logoutHelp: Revoke this device’s session and return to sign-in. On Desktop client mode, the app resets to host.

accessKeys.title: API keys (Webhook / automation)
accessKeys.intro: Bearer keys for Webhook, A2A, and MCP — not for UI sign-in.
accessKeys.baseUrlBody: Use this origin in clients and OpenClaw (same as Settings → External interfaces):
accessKeys.created: New key created — copy it now
accessKeys.empty: No keys yet. Create one for Webhook, scripts, Account manager, or MCP.
accessKeys.revealHelp: Copy and store it safely; the full secret cannot be shown again.

calendarShareMoved: Calendar share sign-in and timezone now live under Subscriptions.
